# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

<!-- cap-evolve:insights-append-below -->

## SpreadsheetBench NL-request interpretation (cand_0001, pending this run's RESULT)
- Promising but not yet tried (this run): the seed agent misreads StackOverflow-style instructions — 160-6 literally wrote a `Sub…End Sub` VBA macro as text into the answer cells instead of performing the delete-blank-rows operation. Fix shipped: "macro/VBA/formula words = the KIND of computation, never text to place; always perform & write DATA values" + worked example.
- Carried-over VERIFIED (prior-run gold checks, re-applied here): (1) deletion/removal ⇒ survivors compact UP, freed bottom cells blank (160-6, 418-29 gold); (2) a DEFINED computation grid fills every cell incl literal 0 (53161 gold), but trailing undefined cells stay None (160-6); (3) PRESERVE source type — keep date-like TEXT as text, cast whole ints back to int — do NOT blanket-coerce (protects 40467/47484 text; re-breaks 160-6 if violated); (4) writing FORMULAS instead of literals regresses recalc-graded lookups (52216, 53161) and defeats in-sandbox self-check — keep literals.
- What didn't (prior RESULT): the formula lever — do not re-test.
